title: Execute selected validation plan and gate adaptive CI rollout
goal: Execute only built-in checks selected by the prerequisite-closed plan, compare adaptive evidence with the full kernel, and switch the ordinary CI path only after parity checks prove no mandatory gate is lost.
inputs: verified E3 impact and validation-plan engine
outputs: parity-mode adaptive execution before full kernel
invariants: Git refs are data arguments and never shell-expanded as commands
unknown change evidence escalates rather than skips
full legacy kernel remains authoritative until adaptive execution parity is proven
security_properties: commit identities are validated before git use
selected executor keys remain closed and built-in
no arbitrary command execution from manifests or plan JSON
acceptance_tests: validationExecutorMode covers every catalogued executor key
push and PR execute adaptive validation before the unchanged full kernel
parity proof exists on push 35798358793 and PR 35798364603
rollout commit runs adaptive strict validation because CI workflows changed
independent full-kernel fallback runs on its creation/modification

performance_budget.rationale: CI adaptation exists to reduce repeated validation cost
metrics: change-set derivation should be negligible compared with validation execution
adaptive runner must not run checks outside the selected prerequisite-closed plan

rollback.strategy: revert adaptive CI integration and restore full legacy kernel execution

definition_of_done: adaptive executor maps every catalog executor_key to built-in reviewed logic
no plan can execute arbitrary shell
strict plans execute all mandatory checks
CI keeps a documented full-kernel fallback
adaptive and full-kernel results are compared before rollout
ordinary push/PR workflow uses real diff plus adaptive validation after parity proof
independent static full-kernel workflow remains available as rollback/fallback evidence
